title: Record.IsDirty in Business Central 29: a worked example
summary: Record.IsDirty() is a new API in Business Central 29 that lets AL code check whether a record instance has changed since it was loaded, eliminating the need to manually track change state. It returns true when in-memory values differ from the database and false when they match.
key_points: Record.IsDirty() returns true when in-memory values differ from what came back from the database, false when they still match
This capability existed for RecordRef since runtime 5.0 but is now available directly on the Record data type in version 29
Developers can use it to decide whether a record needs validating, saving, or user prompts without manual state tracking
Requires runtime 18.0 or later; compiling against runtime 17.0 produces diagnostic AL0666

quotes.text: Record.IsDirty() tells you whether a record instance has changed since it was loaded.
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the core capability that solves the problem of detecting changes without manual state tracking

quotes.text: Set runtime to 18.0 or later in app.json before you build it.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical technical requirement; failure to follow this prevents the feature from working
